description:
Amazon's Selling Partner Support handles tens of millions of contacts annually worldwide. Our science team is transforming this experience by building AI agents that autonomously resolve seller issues, learn from every interaction, and continuously improve with minimal human intervention. These agents reason and adapt — from understanding the seller's context and selecting the right solution, to routing contacts optimally and automating resolution end-to-end. We do this in deep partnership with multiple engineering and product teams.

We are looking for an Applied Scientist who is excited to work on reinforcement learning, agentic architectures, and large-scale production systems. You will be directly connected to the problems sellers face every day, translating real customer pain into science solutions that operate at massive scale. You will frame ambiguous business challenges as tractable machine learning problems and ship systems that measurably improve millions of seller interactions.

Key job responsibilities
- Build evaluation frameworks that measure agent quality across dimensions such as helpfulness, correctness, and safety.
- Own research and development of reinforcement-learning based agent improvement systems, from problem formulation through production deployment and impact measurement.
- Design approaches to preference learning, reward modeling, and policy optimization for conversational agents operating over real-world tools and APIs.
- Collaborate with engineering and product teams to deploy models into production systems serving sellers worldwide.
- Contribute to the team's scientific impact through peer review, mentorship, and publications at peer-reviewed venues.

A day in the life
You read the latest research papers and implement new techniques by building rapid prototypes using AI-assisted coding tools, then take what works from prototype to production. You collaborate closely with product managers and engineering teams to translate seller pain points into deployed science solutions. You work with senior scientists to propose experiments and make the case for what to build next. You also stay connected to the seller experience by understanding the real problems sellers face so your models solve what actually matters.

About the team
Our team is a growing group of scientists building the AI that powers Amazon's seller support experience. We operate across capabilities such as agentic systems, knowledge retrieval, and content automation, each owning distinct problem spaces but sharing evaluation infrastructure and research insights. We work backwards from business problems, deeply understanding the domain and defining success metrics and guardrails. This lets us run parallel experiments, compare approaches rigorously, and ship the best models to production. We publish at both internal and external venues and actively invest in research that compounds over multiple product cycles.

The team sits in Seattle/Vancouver and operates with high autonomy. Scientists own their domains end-to-end, from problem framing through production deployment. We value speed over perfection and experimentation over debate. We value inclusive experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. The team supports an inclusive learning culture where individual growth is a priority — you will find mentorship, knowledge-sharing, and career-advancing resources here.
- Master's degree in computer science, mathematics, statistics, machine learning or equivalent quantitative field
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience with SQL and an RDBMS (e.g., Oracle) or Data Warehouse
- Experience implementing algorithms using both toolkits and self-developed code
- Have publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Operations Research, Statistics, or related fields
- Demonstrated experience leveraging generative AI tools to enhance workflow efficiency and productivity, with the ability to craft effective prompts and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs in a professional setting
- Experience identifying opportunities to integrate AI solutions into products and services to drive business value.
- Building and Scaling Agentic System Components like Memory, Retrieval, Reasoning and Tool Calling

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.
